{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","id":"msg_01XadMURZVddWh9V2TipMUw8","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01J6Ge6qnmqzjeUoPj1W32ma","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/steal.py","content":"import numpy as np\nfrom forward import forward\nfrom scipy.optimize import minimize\nimport warnings\n\nwarnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n\nprint(\"Generating training data by querying forward()...\")\nn_samples = 500\nX_train = np.random.randn(n_samples, 10)\ny_train = np.array([forward(x) for x in X_train])\nprint(f\"Generated {n_samples} training samples\")\n\nbest_h = None\nbest_A1 = None\nbest_loss = float('inf')\n\n# Try different hidden dimensions\nfor h in range(1, 15):\n    print(f\"\\nTrying hidden_dim = {h}...\")\n    n_params = h * 10 + 2 * h + 1\n\n    def loss_fn(params):\n        A1 = params[:h*10].reshape(h, 10)\n        b1 = params[h*10:h*10+h]\n        A2 = params[h*10+h:h*10+2*h]\n        b2 = params[-1]\n\n        total_loss = 0\n        for x, y_true in zip(X_train, y_train):\n            hidden = np.maximum(0, A1 @ x + b1)\n            y_pred = np.dot(A2, hidden) + b2\n            total_loss += (y_pred - y_true) ** 2\n        return total_loss / n_samples\n\n    # Try multiple random initializations\n    best_result_for_h = None\n    best_loss_for_h = float('inf')\n\n    for init_idx in range(15):\n        params_init = np.random.randn(n_params) * 0.1\n        result = minimize(loss_fn, params_init, method='L-BFGS-B')\n\n        if result.fun < best_loss_for_h:\n            best_loss_for_h = result.fun\n            best_result_for_h = result\n\n    print(f\"  Best loss for h={h}: {best_loss_for_h:.2e}\")\n\n    # Check if this is good enough\n    if best_loss_for_h < best_loss:\n        best_loss = best_loss_for_h\n        best_h = h\n        params_opt = best_result_for_h.x\n        best_A1 = params_opt[:h*10].reshape(h, 10)\n\n    # Stop if we get a very good fit\n    if best_loss_for_h < 1e-8:\n        print(f\"\\nFound excellent fit with hidden_dim = {h}!\")\n        params_opt = best_result_for_h.x\n        best_A1 = params_opt[:h*10].reshape(h, 10)\n        best_h = h\n        break\n\nprint(f\"\\n\\nBest fit: hidden_dim = {best_h} with loss = {best_loss:.2e}\")\nprint(f\"A1 shape: {best_A1.shape}\")\n\n# Save the recovered A1\nnp.save('/app/stolen_A1.npy', best_A1)\nprint(f\"Saved A1 to /app/stolen_A1.npy\")\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":9,"cache_creation_input_tokens":5183,"cache_read_input_tokens":21826,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":5183,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":1,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"90d27bcd-52a3-474b-9147-4e38f83dde42","uuid":"f5ee5657-e431-4503-85e9-b73853a8f5e8","request_id":"req_011CbAkaMGMYH9E1woWNyQhN"}

y) ** 2)\n\n        # Backward pass\n        d_output = 2 * (y_pred - y) / n_samples\n\n        # Gradients\n        d_A2 = hidden.T @ d_output\n        d_b2 = np.sum(d_output)\n\n        d_hidden = np.outer(d_output, A2)\n        d_hidden[z <= 0] = 0  # ReLU derivative\n\n        d_A1 = d_hidden.T @ X\n        d_b1 = np.sum(d_hidden, axis=0)\n\n        # Adaptive learning rate\n        if loss < best_loss:\n            best_loss = loss\n            best_A1, best_b1, best_A2, best_b2 = A1.copy(), b1.copy(), A2.copy(), b2\n            patience = 0\n        else:\n            patience += 1\n            if patience > 300:\n                learning_rate *= 0.7\n                patience = 0\n                if learning_rate < 1e-7:\n                    break\n\n        # Update weights\n        A1 -= learning_rate * d_A1\n        b1 -= learning_rate * d_b1\n        A2 -= learning_rate * d_A2\n        b2 -= learning_rate * d_b2\n\n    return best_A1, best_b1, best_A2, best_b2, best_loss\n\n# Test a range of hidden dimensions around the estimated one\nprint(\"\\nFitting models with different hidden dimensions...\\n\")\nbest_h = None\nbest_A1 = None\nbest_loss = float('inf')\n\ntest_range = range(max(1, estimated_h - Initialize weights\n    A1 = np.random.randn(h, n_inputs) * 0.1\n    b1 = np.random.randn(h) * 0.01\n    A2 = np.random.randn(h) * 0.1\n    b2 = np.mean(y)\n\n    # Keep track of best model\n    best_A1, best_b1, best_A2, best_b2 = A1.copy(), b1.copy(), A2.copy(), b2\n    best_loss = float('inf')\n    patience = 0\n\n    for iteration in range(n_iters):\n        # Forward pass\n        z = X @ A1.T + b1  # (n_samples, h)\n        hidden = np.maximum(0, z)  # ReLU\n        y_pred = hidden @ A2 + b2\n\n        # Compute loss\n        loss = np.mean((y_pred - y) ** 2)\n\n        # Backward pass\n        d_output = 2 * (y_pred - y) / n_samples\n\n        # Gradients\n        d_A2 = hidden.T @ d_output\n        d_b2 = np.sum(d_output)\n\n        d_hidden = np.outer(d_output, A2)\n        d_hidden[z <= 0] = 0  # ReLU derivative\n\n        d_A1 = d_hidden.T @ X\n        d_b1 = np.sum(d_hidden, axis=0)\n\n        # Adaptive learning rate: reduce if loss is not improving\n        if loss < best_loss:\n            best_loss = loss\n            best_A1, best_b1, best_A2, best_b2 = A1.copy(), b1.copy(), A2.copy(), b2\n            patience = 0\n        else:\n            patience += 1\n            if patience > 200:\n                learning_rate *= 0.5\n                patience = 0\n                if learning_rate < 1e-7:\n                    break\n\n        # Update weights\n        A1 -= learning_rate * d_A1\n        b1 -= learning_rate * d_b1\n        A2 -= learning_rate * d_A2\n        b2 -= learning_rate * d_b2\n\n        if verbose and iteration % 500 == 0:\n            print(f\"  Iteration {iteration}: loss = {loss:.6e}, lr = {learning_rate:.2e}\")\n\n    return best_A1, best_b1, best_A2, best_b2, best_loss\n\n# Try different hidden dimensions\nprint(\"\\nSearching for the correct hidden dimension...\\n\")\nbest_h = None\nbest_A1 = None\nbest_loss = float('inf')\n\nfor h in range(1, 15):\n    print(f\"Testing hidden_dim = {h}...\")\n\n    # Try multiple random initializations\n    h_best_loss = float('inf')\n    h_best_A1 = None\n\n    for trial in range(10):\n        A1, b1, A2, b2, loss = fit_model(X_train, y_train, h,\n                                         learning_rate=0.01,\n                                         n_iters=5000,\n                                         verbose=False)\n        if loss < h_best_loss:\n            h_best_loss = loss\n            h_best_A1 = A1\n\n    print(f\"  Best loss: {h_best_loss:.6e}\")\n\n    if h_best_loss < best_loss:\n        best_loss = h_best_loss\n        best_h = h\n        best_A1 = h_best_A1\n\n    # Stop if we get a very good fit\n    if h_best_loss < 1e-7:\n        print(f\"  Excellent fit found!\")\n        best_h = h\n        best_A1 = h_best_A1\n        break\n\nprint(f\"\\n\\nBest fit: hidden_dim = {best_h} with loss = {best_loss:.6e}\")\nprint(f\"A1 shape: {best_A1.shape}\")\n\n# Save the recovered A1\nnp.save('/app/stolen_A1.npy', best_A1)\nprint(f\"Saved A1 to /app/stolen_A1.npy\")\n","userModified":false}}

Initialize weights\n    A1 = np.random.randn(h, n_inputs) * 0.1\n    b1 = np.random.randn(h) * 0.01\n    A2 = np.random.randn(h) * 0.1\n    b2 = np.mean(y)\n\n    # Momentum buffers\n    v_A1 = np.zeros_like(A1)\n    v_b1 = np.zeros_like(b1)\n    v_A2 = np.zeros_like(A2)\n    v_b2 = 0.0\n\n    # Keep track of best model\n    best_A1, best_b1, best_A2, best_b2 = A1.copy(), b1.copy(), A2.copy(), b2\n    best_loss = float('inf')\n    patience = 0\n\n    for iteration in range(n_iters):\n        # Forward pass\n        z = X @ A1.T + b1\n        hidden = np.maximum(0, z)\n        y_pred = hidden @ A2 + b2\n\n        # Compute loss\n        loss = np.mean((y_pred - y) ** 2)\n\n        # Backward pass\n        d_output = 2 * (y_pred - y) / n_samples\n\n        # Update momentum\n        v_A1 = momentum * v_A1 - learning_rate * d_A1\n        v_b1 = momentum * v_b1 - learning_rate * d_b1\n        v_A2 = momentum * v_A2 - learning_rate * d_A2\n        v_b2 = momentum * v_b2 - learning_rate * d_b2\n\n        # Save the recovered A1"]}],"originalFile":"import numpy as np\nfrom forward import forward\n\nprint(\"Generating training data by querying forward()...\")\nn_samples = 1000\nX_train = np.random.randn(n_samples, 10)\ny_train = np.array([forward(x) for x in X_train])\nprint(f\"Generated {n_samples} training samples\")\n\n# Step 1: Estimate hidden dimension using Jacobians\nprint(\"\\nEstimating hidden dimension from Jacobians...\")\n\ndef estimate_jacobian(x, eps=1e-5):\n    \"\"\"Estimate the Jacobian at point x using numerical differentiation\"\"\"\n    jacobian = np.zeros(10)\n    f_x = forward(x)\n    for i in range(10):\n        x_perturb = x.copy()\n        x_perturb[i] += eps\n        f_x_perturb = forward(x_perturb)\n        jacobian[i] = (f_x_perturb - f_x) / eps\n    return jacobian\n\n# Collect Jacobians\njacobians = []\nfor i in range(min(100, n_samples)):\n    jac = estimate_jacobian(X_train[i])\n    jacobians.append(jac)\n\njacobians = np.array(jacobians)  # (100, 10)\n\n# Estimate hidden dimension as the rank of the Jacobian matrix\nestimated_h = np.linalg.matrix_rank(jacobians)\nprint(f\"Estimated hidden dimension: {estimated_h}\")\n\n# Step 2: Fit the model\ndef fit_model(X, y, h, learning_rate=0.01, n_iters=5000):\n    \"\"\"Fit a ReLU network using gradient descent with adaptive learning rate\"\"\"\n    n_samples, n_inputs = X.shape\n\n    # Initialize weights\n    A1 = np.random.randn(h, n_inputs) * 0.1\n    b1 = np.random.randn(h) * 0.01\n    A2 = np.random.randn(h) * 0.1\n    b2 = np.mean(y)\n\n    # Keep track of best model\n    best_A1, best_b1, best_A2, best_b2 = A1.copy(), b1.copy(), A2.copy(), b2\n    best_loss = float('inf')\n    patience = 0\n\n    for iteration in range(n_iters):\n        # Forward pass\n        z = X @ A1.T + b1  # (n_samples, h)\n        hidden = np.maximum(0, z)  # ReLU\n        y_pred = hidden @ A2 + b2\n\n        # Compute loss\n        loss = np.mean((y_pred - y) ** 2)\n\n        # Backward pass\n        d_output = 2 * (y_pred - y) / n_samples\n\n        # Gradients\n        d_A2 = hidden.T @ d_output\n        d_b2 = np.sum(d_output)\n\n        d_hidden = np.outer(d_output, A2)\n        d_hidden[z <= 0] = 0  # ReLU derivative\n\n        d_A1 = d_hidden.T @ X\n        d_b1 = np.sum(d_hidden, axis=0)\n\n        # Adaptive learning rate\n        if loss < best_loss:\n            best_loss = loss\n            best_A1, best_b1, best_A2, best_b2 = A1.copy(), b1.copy(), A2.copy(), b2\n            patience = 0\n        else:\n            patience += 1\n            if patience > 300:\n                learning_rate *= 0.7\n                patience = 0\n                if learning_rate < 1e-7:\n                    break\n\n        # Update weights\n        A1 -= learning_rate * d_A1\n        b1 -= learning_rate * d_b1\n        A2 -= learning_rate * d_A2\n        b2 -= learning_rate * d_b2\n\n    return best_A1, best_b1, best_A2, best_b2, best_loss\n\n# Test a range of hidden dimensions around the estimated one\nprint(\"\\nFitting models with different hidden dimensions...\\n\")\nbest_h = None\nbest_A1 = None\nbest_loss = float('inf')\n\ntest_range = range(max(1, estimated_h - 2), min(15, estimated_h + 5))\n\nfor h in test_range:\n    print(f\"Testing hidden_dim = {h}...\")\n\n    # Try multiple random initializations\n    h_best_loss = float('inf')\n    h_best_A1 = None\n\n    for trial in range(15):\n        A1, b1, A2, b2, loss = fit_model(X_train, y_train, h,\n                                         learning_rate=0.01,\n                                         n_iters=5000)\n        if loss < h_best_loss:\n            h_best_loss = loss\n            h_best_A1 = A1\n\n    print(f\"  Best loss: {h_best_loss:.8e}\")\n\n    if h_best_loss < best_loss:\n        best_loss = h_best_loss\n        best_h = h\n        best_A1 = h_best_A1\n\n    # Stop if we get a very good fit\n    if h_best_loss < 1e-8:\n        print(f\"  Excellent fit found!\")\n        best_h = h\n        best_A1 = h_best_A1\n        break\n\nprint(f\"\\n\\nBest fit: hidden_dim = {best_h} with loss = {best_loss:.8e}\")\nprint(f\"A1 shape: {best_A1.shape}\")\n\n# Save the recovered A1\nnp.save('/app/stolen_A1.npy', best_A1)\nprint(f\"Saved A1 to /app/stolen_A1.npy\")\n","userModified":false}}
